# Finesse

> Finesse is a self-hosted streaming service for Linux: one Docker container installs, connects and looks after Jellyfin, Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr, SABnzbd, and qBittorrent (VPN-only via Gluetun), with a polished app for web, phones and LG TVs, plus an optional retro-games library (RomM). Setup is a browser wizard, or a single JSON document applied headlessly — designed so an AI agent can install it for someone.

Key facts:
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoffeeCC/finesse/master/install.sh | bash` (Linux x86-64/ARM64, Docker).
- Headless: write a setup document (JSON Schema below), then `docker exec -i finesse finesse setup apply - < setup.json`. Idempotent and resumable.
- Health: `docker exec finesse finesse doctor [--json]`. Credentials test: `finesse setup check - < setup.json`.
- Torrents only ever run through the VPN; secrets never leave the server; only containers labelled `finesse.managed` are touched.

## Install

- [Runbook for AI agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoffeeCC/finesse/master/docs/agents/INSTALL.md): step-by-step install with commands, expected output and fixes
- [Install guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoffeeCC/finesse/master/docs/install.md): requirements, the wizard, after setup, troubleshooting, security
- [Setup document schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoffeeCC/finesse/master/setup.schema.json): every field of the setup JSON, with descriptions
- [Example setup documents](https://github.com/CoffeeCC/finesse/tree/master/examples/setup): minimal, Usenet, full
- [Use an existing Jellyfin/*arr setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoffeeCC/finesse/master/docs/adopt.md): adopt mode and migrating older installs
- [TrueNAS SCALE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoffeeCC/finesse/master/docs/truenas.md): install from the Apps page (Install via YAML), adopt or full install
- [Groups](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoffeeCC/finesse/master/docs/groups.md): share films, shows and music between Finesse servers (watch- and listen-only), pairing codes, share back
- [Watch on a TV](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoffeeCC/finesse/master/docs/tv.md): installing the LG webOS app, other TVs' browsers, Jellyfin apps
- [Games](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoffeeCC/finesse/master/docs/games.md): the optional retro-games library (RomM), folder layout, artwork keys

## Develop

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CoffeeCC/finesse/master/AGENTS.md): layout, commands, rules, testing, releasing
